# Singularity Networks Framework

Unified SNF client/server monorepository.

## Repository layout

- server/ — canonical .NET server source and tests
- client/ — canonical Member App, Admin Console, and shared core workspace
- shared/ — repository-level shared material
- tests/ — repository-level test documentation
- docs/ — architecture, planning, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and security documentation
- infra/ — canonical local Docker orchestration
- scripts/ — deterministic verification scripts

